system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

You become ethereal, just as an attack would strike you. As a reaction, when you would be hit by an attack or would make a saving throw that would deal damage to you, you can spend 1 Superiority Die, when you do, you become incorporeal just as the attack would hit you. You gain DR equal to 5 x the current number of Ghostfire you have.
